title: C13 Route Handlers + Edge + proxy.ts (OWNS proxy.ts)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: proxy.ts (Node runtime, Next.js 16) auth-gates /account: an unauthenticated request (no cookie) AND a request with a tampered/expired cookie are both redirected to login and never receive /account HTML; a valid session passes through (QA critical: unauthenticated requests to /account are blocked and redirected; forged/tampered cookie is rejected). proxy.ts imports auth via the FROZEN lib/auth interface only.
proxy.ts also performs a locale redirect and an A/B rewrite, and NOTES.md documents that middleware.ts is the legacy/Edge equivalent and why proxy.ts (Node) is used here in v16.
A search Route Handler returns matching products as JSON, and NOTES.md documents the GET route-handler caching footgun (when a GET handler is/ isn't cached in v16 and how to opt in/out).

An explicit runtime='edge' Route Handler demonstrates the Edge restricted-API lesson (Web APIs only, no Node APIs) and reads geolocation; NOTES.md lists at least two Node APIs that are unavailable at the Edge (QA non-blocker: edge runtime cold-start observed/documented).

The c13 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers + cache-flow diagram for the GET caching behaviour), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
